verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a feature-flag and experimentation platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The Bayesian statistics engine is statistical analysis, not AI suggestions. The 'intelligent release assistant' wording describes rule-based pipeline automation. The MCP server lets external AI assistants act on the Admin API rather than generating insights within Flagsmith.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
